2607.11874.title: A Minimalist Retargeting-Guided Reinforcement Learning Recipe for Dexterous Manipulation
2607.11874.paper_summary: Recent work in humanoid whole-body control has found success with a simple recipe: retarget human motion to robot kinematic references, then train policies via reinforcement learning (RL) to track them. But how does this recipe transfer to dexterous manipulation? The answer is not obvious, as manipulation involves complex, contact-rich dynamics and requires delicate regulation of contact modes and forces. We present REGRIND, a minimalist retargeting-guided RL pipeline that learns dexterous manipulation policies from a single human demonstration. REGRIND retargets human hand-object motion to a robot reference that preserves hand-object spatial and contact relationships, trains a residual RL policy in simulation to track object-centric keypoints along that reference, and transfers the resulting policy zero-shot to hardware with careful system identification. The resulting policies produce fluid, human-like behavior on two different multi-fingered hands across contact-rich tool-use tasks, including operating a pair of scissors and turning a screwdriver. Through systematic hardware experiments, we identify and analyze the key factors that govern sim-to-real transfer in dexterous manipulation, offering practical guidance for retargeting-based learning in contact-rich settings. Videos and code are available at https://yunhaifeng.com/REGRIND.
2607.11874.paper_summary_zh: 最近在類人全身控制方面的研究取得了成功，使用了一個簡單的配方：將人類運動重新定向到機器人的運動學參考，然後通過強化學習（RL）訓練策略以跟踪它們。<lb/>但這個配方如何轉移到靈巧操作上呢？答案並不明顯，因為操作涉及複雜且接觸豐富的動力學，並需要對接觸模式和力量進行精細調節。<lb/>我們提出了REGRIND，一個極簡的重新定向引導的RL管道，從單一的人類示範中學習靈巧操作策略。<lb/>REGRIND將人類手部與物體的運動重新定向到一個保留手部與物體空間和接觸關係的機器人參考，並在模擬中訓練一個殘差RL策略，以沿著該參考跟踪以物體為中心的關鍵點，然後通過仔細的系統識別將結果策略零樣本轉移到硬體上。<lb/>所得到的策略在兩種不同的多指手上產生流暢的人類般行為，涵蓋了接觸豐富的工具使用任務，包括操作一把剪刀和轉動一個螺絲刀。<lb/>通過系統的硬體實驗，我們識別並分析了影響靈巧操作中模擬到現實轉移的關鍵因素，為接觸豐富環境中的重新定向學習提供了實用指導。<lb/>視頻和代碼可在 https://yunhaifeng.com/REGRIND 獲得。
